notes.title: Patch 1.1 Released
notes.content:
We released a usability patch today that addresses the following:

- Added an options menu with the following options:
    - Master Volume
    - Sensitivity (affects both mouse and controller)
    - Look Inversion (for those of you playing with controllers)
    - Subtitles
- Added subtitles to all videos and levels if the option is marked
- Overhauled controls on the rabbit level, this should be much more intuitive and easier to play
- Tweaked the truck level so that it is much harder to flip over
- Removed some invisible walls from the truck level
- Made tweaks to the beginning office level
    - Added a hint at the beginning to find the phone
    - You now must collect all 3 objects to trigger the power down event
    - You now must collect all 3 objects before you can go to the basement
- Improved performance on the spring puzzle level
- Main menu can now be navigated with a mouse
- Menus can also be navigated when hitting enter
- Fixed various frame rate and optimization issues

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
We released a small patch today that addresses the following:

 Achievements should now unlock at the correct points
 Fixed a small geometry issue where a vine wouldn't rotate during the Bedroom Puzzle level
 Expanded trigger during Winter level near the bike pedals.


We're showing this weekend at PAX East at the Indie Minibooth, come stop by and say hi if you're in the area! We'd love to hear what you think.

We are also beginning work on the first big patch that will hopefully improve QOL.
